name: FareOptions
description: The fare matrix shown when a flight result is expanded: one card per fare family with its price, inclusions and a Choose action.

provenance.tag: Structure: A · unverified (expandable fare columns). Fare names: Official.

props.name: fares
props.description: family: Economy Saver / Flex / Flex Plus; Business Special / Saver / Flex / Flex Plus; Premium Economy; First (Official).

rules: First Class uses Card variant="premium" and Button variant="premium".
File A's names ("Economy Special", "Economy Flex", "Business Saver", "First Class") are not used. "Economy Special" does not appear among the Official fare names.
Fare names come from fare data, never hardcoded.

ambiguities.description: Named FareOptions in inventory.md and FareOptionsMatrix in overview.md, scope-boundaries.md and state-architecture.md. Same component.
